easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
description:
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating an artifact creature token.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
